rows.basis: Growth in gross 'Computer, network, machinery and equipment': 12,844M − 9,508M = 3,336M. This counts all server, network and machinery growth, net of disposals, not only AI. It predates the AI buildout and excludes buildings, land and construction in progress.

Growth in gross 'Computer, network, machinery and equipment': 17,258M − 12,844M = 4,414M. This counts all server, network and machinery growth, not only AI, and excludes the 3.3B rise in construction in progress and building growth.

Growth in gross 'Computer, network, machinery and equipment': 20,989M − 17,258M = 3,731M. This counts all server, network and machinery growth, not only AI. Shell, land and construction in progress are excluded.

Growth in gross 'Computer, network, machinery and equipment': 30,345M − 20,989M = 9,356M. This counts all server, network and machinery growth, not only AI. It excludes the 10.9B rise in construction in progress and finance-leased equipment (finance lease liability 2.9B at year end).

Growth in gross 'Computer, network, machinery and equipment': 59,634M − 30,345M = 29,289M. This counts all server, network and machinery growth, not only AI. The company says the capex program supports 'AI Cloud Infrastructure' but gives total-scope words only, so the 55.7B total is not used as the AI part. Construction in progress (+23.5B) and finance leases (liability 2.9B to 7.7B) are excluded.
The earnings release says 'For years Oracle has been investing in AI and building autonomous cloud software.' It gives no amount or share of operating expense.
